en: The image is a vintage black-and-white view of a busy harbor with several large ocean liners or passenger ships anchored in the water. Dock cranes and industrial shipping infrastructure are visible in the foreground, and a hilly or low-rise cityscape stretches across the horizon in the background. The photo style and printing method suggest an early to mid-20th century era.
